about_the_game:
This is a puzzle game where the objective is to get from point A to point B. In this game you will solve puzzles by manipulating the gravity of either yourself or other objects. You will use gravity to destroy destructible surfaces and navigate through spaces that are not physically possible in real life.

In the first level you will get the Gravity Manipulator which you will use to add a gravity source for other objects in the level to use, this gravity source uses Newtonian gravity (Sir Issac Newton's gravity equations) so as objects get close to this gravity source the gravitational strength increases exponentially, accelerating these objects to extreme speeds. You will use this to destroy destructible surfaces like doors or sometimes your helmet.

The Gravity Manipulator also has a pull mode that will simply move objects to the gravity source and will be used to position the objects in specific locations which will allow you to use the Player to Object mode and slingshot yourself through the center of gravity. This can be used reach otherwise unreachable locations. There will also be points in the game where you can change your direction of gravity, which will also be used to reach unreachable locations.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: N/A
  • Processor: Intel Core I7-4700MQ or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GT 750M
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: This game works well on both an SSD and HDD. In order to use DLSS you will have to force the game to use proton with the Windows version. The specifications here are just what I have been able to test, it might work on less powerful hardware.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: N/A
  • Processor: Intel Core I5-10300H or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 TI
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: This game works well on both an SSD and HDD. In order to use DLSS you will have to force the game to use proton with the Windows version. The specifications here are just what I have been able to test, it might work on less powerful hardware.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: MacOS 13 Ventura
  • Processor: Apple Silicon M1
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 8 Core GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: This game works well on both an SSD and HDD. The MacOS version is very untested, I only tested it with an Apple M1 CPU and it works on that. Intel is untested, so buy at your own risk or use a compatability layer with the Windows version. The specifications here are just what I have been able to test, on this hardware it DOES NOT run well, but the game does work on MacOS.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core I7-4700MQ or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GT 750M
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: This game works well on both an SSD and HDD. There is an in-game setting for DirectX 11, 12, or Vulkan, Vulkan is default. The specifications here are just what I have been able to test, it might work on less powerful hardware.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core I5-10300H or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 TI
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Windows 11 is recommended for HDR support. This game works well on both an SSD and HDD. There is an in-game setting for DirectX 11, 12, or Vulkan, Vulkan is default. The specifications here are just what I have been able to test, it might work on less powerful hardware.

short_description: Trapped in a space station, your only way out is to solve puzzles by manipulating gravity. In this game you will destroy destructible surfaces and go through non euclidean impossible spaces.
